input.free_text_description: The system operates in the e-commerce, user management domain. It serves Customer, User as its primary actors. The main business capabilities include custom error, home, login. Core business data revolves around Product, Role, User.

user_stories.story: As a Customer, I want to log into the system, so that I can access my personalized dashboard and features.
As a Customer, I want to add items to a shopping cart and check out, so that I can conveniently collect items before purchasing.
As a Customer, I want to browse and manage products, so that I can find and interact with the product catalog.
As a Customer, I want to manage user accounts and profiles, so that user information stays current and accurate.
As a Customer, I want to manage custom error operations, so that the relevant business process is handled efficiently.
